answer.room: a long, narrow, empty living room in a contemporary minimalist style: white walls, exposed grey concrete ceiling, light natural oak plank floor, black-framed sliding door to a balcony, a bare pendant bulb near the window

pieces.piece: a three-seat sofa against the long left wall, in the middle of the room, facing the right wall
pieces.why: the sofa they asked for anchors the TV area, and a low light-grey fabric sofa on slim legs keeps this narrow room open and suits the concrete ceiling and oak floor
pieces.query:
Type: sofa, three-seat upholstered
Use: sitting and watching TV; living room
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, light oak or black metal legs
Colors: light warm grey, greige
Shape: low, straight track arms, slim raised legs, compact depth, medium visual weight
Feel: calm, comfortable, airy
Goes with: white walls, grey concrete ceiling, light oak floor, black window frames; contemporary minimalist living room

pieces.piece: a low TV stand on the right wall, facing the sofa, near the outlets
pieces.why: the TV needs a base at seated eye level, and a long, shallow oak and black stand holds it without narrowing the passage along the room
pieces.query:
Type: TV stand, low and long
Use: holding the TV and storing media; living room
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Japandi
Materials: light oak wood, black metal
Colors: natural light oak, black

Feel: clean, orderly, warm
Goes with: light oak floor, black window frames, white walls, grey concrete ceiling; contemporary minimalist living room

pieces.piece: a small round dining table by the balcony door, under the existing ceiling light
pieces.why: the table they asked for to eat at fits best in the bright window end, using the room's full length, and a round light-oak top on a black base keeps traffic flowing to the balcony
